verdict.rationale: Whether customer data is used for model training is a fair privacy question for a cloud sandbox service that handles user code and files. The evidence pack contains no training-data policy, opt-out control, or no-training commitment. The self-hosting and BYOC deployment options are adjacent deployment choices, not a documented training-data control, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
